rca_of_issue:
TEST 3 RCA (suspected): The annoprec branch at home/index.tsx:1957-1995 relies on `filtered` which is the upstream mercatoFiltered array. If `mercatoFiltered` only includes current-year data (due to a previous time filter), lastMarketOf(yearCur-1) will return null and the 2025 bar will not render. Recommend inspecting mercatoFiltered build logic at lines ~1820-1880 and confirming it preserves multi-year data when chartMode='annoprec'.

TEST 2 RCA (suspected): The Round 67 fornitoriTotals try-block at stats.tsx:931-969 builds daysIso from `new Date(g.data).getFullYear()/getMonth()+1/getDate()` in LOCAL timezone, then compares against `sp.dayOfPurchase` which is a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string. If sp.dayOfPurchase was originally produced from a UTC ISO `toISOString().slice(0,10)`, the dates may not match (UTC-shifted by 1 day in negative timezones). Verify by logging both daysIso contents and sp.dayOfPurchase values during test run. Alternative: the per-fornitore breakdown UI may simply not be expanded — check screenshot of expanded FORNITORI section to confirm whether 'Fatturata' line shows €120.
